decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records the selected graduated-orange and black colour treatments and removes the obsolete overall colour direction.
Selecting rev8-11 verifies the revised letterforms but does not change any current letterform requirement attributes; that verification is already represented.
The client explicitly refines the strapline treatment from generic graduated colours to graduated orange matching GLOBAL.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I mistakenly thought I had already replied! We’d like to proceed with the final version shown above, rev8-11. Thank you.

Am I right that the logo will be provided both with and without the black box, since that background will not suit every use? Will we also receive every colour variant you have shown?

For the main logo, our preference is the top-row treatment from the final version: graduated orange for ‘global’, black for ‘dough’ and graduated orange for the strapline.

We now need the logo guidelines and every relevant file type for online use, social media, the truck and hard-copy materials such as pull-up banners, printed menus and uniforms. Given the large file sizes, how will you share them—through Wetransfer? Thank you, Tessa

decisions.reason: The selection of rev8-11 does not alter the company name, exclusion of the word truck, or wider-business representation.
The source specifies the strapline's colour treatment but does not change the requirement to include the existing strapline.
The source does not identify a new flame/O treatment or alter the requirement that the symbol remain recognizable as an O.
Approving rev8-11 does not modify the existing clean-but-characterful visual-style constraints.
Final composition selection does not change the earlier task-local requirements governing initial concept development.
The composition-baseline change does not itself modify cross-media suitability; the separate request for deliverable formats is not a propagated effect of that change.
Selecting the final revision does not alter the originality requirement or the inspiration-only role of the AI-generated draft.
The colour-variant request is already represented by a same-message INTRODUCE and requires no correction from the composition-baseline change.
The approved composition and colour treatment do not change the existing obligation to supply brand colour details.
